name: Kemono & Pawchive Archive Ripper
description: Save Discord archives and Patreon/Fanbox posts from Kemono and Pawchive in an on-page overlay.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://kemono.cr https://*.kemono.cr https://pawchive.pw https://*.pawchive.pw https://cdn.discordapp.com https://media.discordapp.net; img-src 'self' blob: data: https://*.kemono.cr https://*.pawchive.pw; style-src 'self';
